action.mapping: u = a/|a|; |a| < 1e-6 or non-finite -> hold the current velocity direction (+x at rest); never A0 guidance

asset: v_s = 0 (stationary after reset); canonical reset places it at the origin on the ground; relative geometry randomized through the attacker spawn + heading

defender.note: the environment clamps any defender into the 50 m volume; ground corner chosen to minimize interference (A0 min separation 9.0 m over 600 episodes, defender visible within 25 m in ~7.5% of episodes, stationary)
defender.semantics: established passive/parked: standby disabled, never acts, state retained

early_stopping: stop a seed at the second consecutive passing validation; FAIL if not mastered by rollout 8

final_evaluation.a0_reference: scripted canonical A0 on the identical scenarios

hypothesis: PPO can learn reliable asset capture under canonical attacker dynamics when the asset is stationary and defender/clutter complexity is removed.

pathology_definition.gate: pathology rate <= 2% and zero orbit episodes

stage_pass: >= 2 of 3 seeds mastered, every mastered seed passes the final 200-episode held-out gates, no common structural pathology

training_geometry.attacker_spawn: canonical: uniform edge of the 50 m square perimeter, uniform position along the edge, altitude U(10, 30) m
training_geometry.initial_heading: line of sight rotated by alpha ~ U(0, 90.0) deg, uniform azimuth; vertical rate clipped as in the canonical reset
training_geometry.scenario_stream: SeedSequence([0xc1a1, ppo_seed, worker, rollout]); seeds in [1000000, 2147483647)
